description: Google Search Console MCP by DigestSEO for search analytics, clicks, impressions, CTR, rankings, URL inspection, sitemap management, indexing workflows, SEO diagnostics, comparisons, and weekly reports.

notes: Google OAuth is used for Search Console access. The hosted DigestSEO endpoint opens the Google sign-in flow; self-hosted Cloudflare Worker deployments provide their own Google OAuth configuration.

clients: other MCP clients supporting Streamable HTTP

notes: Metadata matches the public repository README and documented DigestSEO-hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. The npm self-hosting launcher starts a local Cloudflare Workers HTTP server, so TensorBlock client config should prefer the hosted /mcp endpoint rather than treat the npm command as a stdio MCP process.
